name: Crew1
speechStyle: quiet, chooses words like spare parts
backstoryHint: Crew1 served as comms officer aboard the MSV Perilune. When the Lien boarded, they were mid-shift in the cargo spine when the lights went red and stayed red. Their bunkmate never made it out of the forward section.
